shared_elements: low-relief carved human figures in strict profile
bearded male figures with elaborate coiffure/headdress
figures standing/striding with arms raised or extended
patterned garments with dense parallel incised lines
registers/bands of figures along a wall surface
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief bearded human figures in strict profile with elaborately curled hair/beards and finely striated garments, and both include stylized plant motifs, which is a fairly specific shared convention of figural rendering. However A is a single large winged, kneeling/leaning figure engaging a stylized tree in a closely interlocked composition, whereas B is a continuous procession of repeated upright figures in file along a stair facade, so the relationships and arrangement differ considerably.
